claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_light_zone
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight's entire mechanical purpose is creating illumination (Bright Light + Dim Light) in an area. No v4 effect atom covers environmental lighting. The closest atoms — grant_sense, modify_roll_numeric, negate_named_effect — are all wrong for this. Illumination has deterministic combat consequences (darkness/light conditions, hiding, Blinded suppression) so dm_agenda is not appropriate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight's alternative mode attaches to a physical object (not worn/carried), causing sunlight to emanate from that object. The v4 taxonomy includes an `object` attachment atom, but types.ts Attachment union does not include it. This is a surface_widening within the existing taxonomy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.area.shape.emanation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Object-mode Daylight produces a 60-foot Emanation (centered on the object, moves with it). The surface area attachment only supports sphere shape. Emanation is a distinct area shape (origin tracks an object rather than a fixed point).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the sunlight.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.conditional_dispel
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight passively dispels any overlapping darkness spell of level 3 or lower. This is not negate_named_effect (which targets a specific spell by id), not suppress (which suspends a named effect), and not triggered_reaction (it fires automatically on spatial overlap, not via a reaction). A new conditional_dispel operation is needed, parameterized by spell level cap and overlap condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
